node.title: Rate-half exceptional distance-three MDS-escape router
node.statement: On the official A=1 core-one exceptional-only quotient-distance-three chart, every ordinary supported slope is either an internal fiber cancelling exactly two exceptional-root source coefficients, or a disjoint minimum-weight Vandermonde escape. The official incidence budget forces exactly e internal fibers, whose pairs partition the 2e exceptional roots, and exactly 3e external escapes. Each external locator G obeys G(t)/A(t)=constant on the canonical triple, and the total outside-row incidence deficit is exactly e. This is an exact router, not an exclusion of the chart.
